title: ODbL share-alike / CC-BY compatibility ruling for cBioPortal (blocking)
context: PLAN.md v0.2 establishes that cBioPortal's default license is ODC-ODbL (share-alike), not CC-BY. CC-BY-4.0-licensed documentation derived from an ODbL share-alike database may create a license-compatibility conflict. Until a credentialed License + Genomic-Privacy reviewer provides a standing ruling, ALL cBioPortal sources are FLAG status and no cBioPortal datasheet may PASS the gate. This ruling is an M0 exit criterion and a hard blocker on every cBioPortal task. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE. Depends on license-matrix-005 and reviewer-001.
objective: Obtain a written reviewer ruling on whether CC-BY-4.0-licensed documentation derived from an ODbL share-alike source (cBioPortal) creates a license conflict, and record the standing rule and any required mitigation in the gate and policy artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: License + Genomic-Privacy reviewer provides a written ruling with cited legal analysis on ODbL share-alike vs. CC-BY-4.0 documentation compatibility.
Ruling committed to /docs/odbl-share-alike-ruling.md with the date, reviewer identity, and cited sources (primary legal sources or prior art, not self-assertion).

gate-004 checklist and policy-006 updated to reference the ruling; any required mitigation (e.g. relicensing documentation under ODbL-compatible terms or recording a specific study exemption) is stated.
license-matrix-005 updated to record cBioPortal as ODC-ODbL default with shareAlike:true and the per-study verification requirement.
No cBioPortal datasheet may PASS the gate until this ruling is committed; ruling document explicitly states the effective date and scope.
